description: This file declares functions for collecting device and Zigbee network statistics, firmware events, channel scan stats, camera device stats, and device service status within a Zigbee-enabled device service module.

methods.name: collectAllDeviceStatistics
methods.description: Collects all device-related statistics and adds them to the runtime statistics hash map.

methods.name: collectZigbeeNetworkCounters
methods.description: Collects Zigbee network counters from the Zigbee core.

methods.name: collectZigbeeCoreNetworkStatistics
methods.description: Gathers Zigbee core network status information such as panID, channel, and eui64.

methods.name: collectAllDeviceFirmwareEvents
methods.description: Retrieves firmware failure events for Zigbee devices.

methods.name: collectCameraDeviceStats
methods.description: Collects statistics related to camera devices.
